{{Top}}
'''Air scoops''' were components that could be attached to a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer's]] engines to act as steering brakes in turns, maximizing efficiency. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] added three yellow air scoops to each of his two engines.
